families.title: Abstraction partition coverage
families.hypothesis: A declared abstraction partitions the finite concrete state set without omission, overlap or empty block.

families.title: Abstract edge projection
families.hypothesis: Concrete transitions project deterministically into a deduplicated abstract transition relation.

families.title: Spurious abstract trace challenge
families.hypothesis: An abstract action trace is marked spurious exactly when no declared concrete action trace realizes it.

families.title: Concrete trace-lift coverage
families.hypothesis: Each adjacent abstract state step exposes its declared concrete transition candidates without claiming real behavior.

families.title: Counterexample-guided refinement split
families.hypothesis: A numeric synthetic predicate splits a declared abstract block into disjoint complete refinements.

families.title: Purpose-bounded scope intersection
families.hypothesis: Only requested scopes that are also granted remain in the synthetic permitted projection.

families.title: Timestamped expiry-window state
families.hypothesis: A normalized timestamp triple yields premature, active or expired without conferring real authorization.

families.title: Consent-event lineage projection
families.hypothesis: A finite ordered grant, correction and revocation fixture produces an as-of synthetic scope projection.

families.title: Declared remedy-route coverage
families.hypothesis: Every issue code is either mapped to a declared synthetic review route or retained as unresolved.

families.title: Appeal-window vacancy and timing
families.hypothesis: A synthetic submission is labelled timely, late or missing while remedy authority remains reserved.

families.title: Field-level disclosure minimization
families.hypothesis: A synthetic projection releases only the intersection of requested, allowed and present fields.

families.title: Counterexample explanation coverage
families.hypothesis: Missing required explanation categories remain explicit instead of being inferred from partial text.

families.title: Accessible alternative-action set
families.hypothesis: Declared role prerequisites determine synthetic available alternatives and explicit withheld reasons.

families.title: Review-quorum vacancy
families.hypothesis: Missing declared review roles remain an authority vacancy rather than a synthetic approval.

families.title: Accessibility-mode vacancy
families.hypothesis: Missing declared delivery modes remain explicit and manual affected-user evaluation stays reserved.

families.title: Observation-model-assumption separation
families.hypothesis: Synthetic observation, model, assumption and unknown records remain separated and cannot convert into empirical evidence.

families.title: Unit-dimension composition guard
families.hypothesis: Synthetic arithmetic proceeds only for matching declared dimensions; no real measurement is inferred.

families.title: Bounded workload trace
families.hypothesis: A finite ordered cost fixture retains held work when the declared synthetic budget is exhausted.

families.title: Reversible checkpoint frontier
families.hypothesis: The latest declared reversible checkpoint is exposed while every real rollback remains an open gap.

families.title: Delegation-scope authority vacancy
families.hypothesis: Unverified delegation or missing scope remains exact-gated and cannot be promoted by software.
